mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (conversation_id, sender_user_id, msg_type, content, create_time) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderUserId}, #{msgType}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT msg_id, conversation_id, sender_user_id, msg_type, content, create_time FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY msg_id DESC
SELECT MAX(msg_id) FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
